findings.description: Creating a Stripe Checkout Session always sends each line item with quantity 1, so multi-quantity cart lines are undercharged compared to the in-app cart total.
reproSteps: POST http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/checkout/session with body items containing one line: Organic Bananas (6 ct) at price 3.49 and quantity 2 (same payload the frontend sends for two bananas).
Use the Stripe API (or dashboard) to retrieve that Checkout Session and inspect amount_total and line item quantities.
findings.observedBehavior: Session cs_test_a12t6fRjf38SQ9bPa8Z5qsHcUkU1f8VUI45xFPjyiJ5jPRFhhcaIiQZc4W had amount_total 349 (USD cents), one line item for Organic Bananas with quantity 1 and amount_subtotal 349, while the request specified quantity 2 ($6.98 expected).
findings.expectedBehavior: Stripe amount_total and per-line quantities should match the cart: $6.98 (698 cents) for two units at $3.49, consistent with sum(price * quantity) shown in the app.
